I adjust about -35 billion from the July 2025 print for stronger tariff/customs receipts and partial mean reversion from the 20% year-over-year 2025 jump, then add back about +14 billion for higher interest, mandatory outlays, defense, and enacted tax-policy deficit pressure, for a net update near -21 billion to a 270.0 median.
